name: @gjsify/oxfmt-native
description: Vala/GObject + Rust cdylib bridge to oxc's formatter (oxfmt) for GJS. Formats JavaScript/TypeScript/JSX under GJS without a Node runtime — the Node-free counterpart to the npm `oxfmt` native napi binary, backing `gjsify format` under GJS. Wraps oxc_formatter (Prettier-compatible) via a single-shot FFI; the embedded CSS/HTML/Markdown ExternalFormatter (Prettier-NAPI) is out of scope.

scripts.clear: rm -rf lib build tsconfig.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.types.tsbuildinfo || exit 0
scripts.build: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:types
scripts.build:meson: gjsify run init:meson && meson compile -C build
scripts.build:prebuilds: gjsify run build:meson && mkdir -p prebuilds/linux-x86_64 && cp build/libgjsifyoxfmt.so build/libgjsify_oxfmt.so build/GjsifyOxfmt-1.0.gir build/GjsifyOxfmt-1.0.typelib prebuilds/linux-x86_64/

author: Pascal Garber <pascal@artandcode.studio>
